author: Aevy TV
description:
AI Data Centers are suddenly popping up everywhere. If you asked Big Tech about it, they'd say that you use AI, so you need these Data Centers. If you asked the activists on the internet, they'd tell you that every AI prompt you enter is directly causing a severe water crisis. In this video, we investigate the actual costs of your AI use, the impending water crisis that Data Centers seem to be escalating, and what you can do to play your part in navigating this crisis.
